outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: Pregnant women (n=357) diagnosed with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) at the Department of Perinatology, Ministry of Health Ankara City Hospital between January 1, 2021, and June 1, 2023.
finding: The Aggregate index of systemic inflammation (AISI) was significantly higher in women with PPROM who experienced NICU admission, chorioamnionitis, or delivered before 28 or 34 weeks of gestation.
gest_age: Preterm, with specific analyses for gestational age at birth <28 weeks and <34 weeks.
